steps.assertion: Start on the signed-in Odoo home page
steps.text: Use a training workspace with an approved expense batch and permission to post expenses. Sign in with your usual company account. You arrive on **Home**.
Choose the application menu in the upper-left corner.
Open **Expenses**. You will work with an example that combines a hotel paid by the employee and a meal paid by the company.

steps.assertion: Open the list of expense batches
steps.text: Open **Expense Batches**. Find the approved training trip prepared for you.
Open **Training seminar**, or the equivalent example in your training workspace.

steps.assertion: Accounting receives the approved mixed-payer Batch
steps.text: Read the summary before posting. Identify who paid for each expense and follow the amounts through the next screens.

steps.assertion: Post the company-paid side and open native reimbursement
steps.text: Choose **Post Batch**. Odoo posts the company-paid expense and opens a separate confirmation for the amount the employee advanced.

steps.assertion: Complete the native employee-paid posting wizard
steps.text: Check the journal and accounting date, then choose **Post Expenses** to record the employee-paid expense.

steps.assertion: Both mixed-payer journal entries are available for review
steps.text: You have posted your first batch. Compare the two amounts shown with the summary. The company charge and the employee reimbursement each have their own entry.

title: From your first sign-in to your first posted expense batch
